name: tool-lines
about: Another tool's call is a line in the thread (11 Nov 2026, core/agents.js stepKind 'tool' and 'helper'): in a Bypass Code chat on lab-sandbox that works directly, the session is asked to hand a small look-up to a subagent. The stretch's line under the message says so ("handed part of it to a helper", or the hand-off's own line when it's the only step). Whether the model really uses a subagent is its own choice, so that check is soft; that its work shows as a line, and that it answers, are not. Needs the real Claude Code (a --fake lab's Chat isn't on the plan, so nothing goes directly there).

steps.ask: Use a subagent (your Task tool) to count how many test() calls there are in src/convert.test.js, then tell me the number in one sentence. Don't change anything.

steps.note: Its work as a line under the message.
The hand-off said in the line (the model's own choice to use one: soft).
